caseStudies.title: Zero-Downtime Migration of 200+ Payment Gateways
caseStudies.challenge: Mastercard's Virtual MIP fleet of 200+ nodes was running CentOS 7 approaching end-of-life, creating compliance and security exposure for systems processing millions of daily payment transactions.
caseStudies.approach: Designed a phased migration strategy with custom pipeline logic that handled node-by-node OS transitions from CentOS 7 to Oracle Linux 8. Built automated validation gates ensuring each node was fully operational before proceeding to the next.
caseStudies.outcome: Achieved zero data loss and 100% service continuity across the entire fleet. No customer-facing impact during the migration window.

caseStudies.title: Global Virtualization: Physical to vMIP at Scale
caseStudies.challenge: Mastercard needed to convert physical payment infrastructure to virtualized nodes across 200+ global endpoints to improve scalability and reduce provisioning bottlenecks from weeks to minutes.
caseStudies.approach: Architected an ISO-based deployment solution that standardized the conversion process. Created reusable automation templates that could be applied across diverse hardware and network configurations globally.
caseStudies.outcome: Completed the conversion of 200+ endpoints in under 2 months — a timeline previously considered impossible. Provisioning dropped from weeks to minutes.

caseStudies.title: Next-Gen Certificate Management for PCI Compliance
caseStudies.challenge: Manual mTLS certificate management across Mastercard's payment gateway fleet was error-prone, audit-risky, and consumed significant engineering hours — a critical liability in a PCI-regulated environment.
caseStudies.approach: Designed NECMS (Next-Gen Certificate Management System) integrating Venafi for certificate authority and Ansible for automated lifecycle management. Built self-service workflows for high-value client onboarding.
caseStudies.outcome: Eliminated manual certificate toil entirely. Achieved continuous PCI compliance with automated rotation, monitoring, and audit trail generation.

caseStudies.title: API Gateway Serving 5M+ Daily Requests
caseStudies.challenge: Mastercard needed a next-generation API Gateway capable of handling 5 million+ concurrent requests per day with zero-downtime deployment capability.
caseStudies.approach: Led a team of 6 engineers to deploy NGINX Plus with automated policy management. Built CI/CD pipelines using Chef Habitat and XL Release for seamless upgrades. Optimized XML Gateway through Groovy/Jenkins automation.
caseStudies.outcome: Successfully deployed gateway handling 5M+ requests/day. Reduced policy deployment costs by 30% and deployment errors by 90%.
